title.narrative: DIBE. Explorer 2018 KM Fish Machinery A/S

description.narrative: Danida Innovation & Business Explorer (DIBE) offers financial support to Danish companies, including start-ups, that wish to investigate concrete business opportunities contributing to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris agreement. The expected results of the project will be (1) A significant strengthening of Bangladesh's fish processing industry focusing on sustainability, quality and efficiency, (2) Improved competitiveness and increased independence for Bangladesh's fish industry.(3) Jobs Created in both Denmark and Bangladesh (4) Increased trade between Denmark and Bangladesh.

Exploring the possibilities for a more permanent establishment of KM Fish Machinery on the market in terms of a service workshop and at a later stage part production.
Key results: Business plan for permanent establishment of KM Fish Machinery in Bangladesh in form of a service workshop and at a later stage part production. Justification for support: The support is granted to incentivise Danish companies to contribute to sustainable growth and employment in developing countries. Major risks and challenges: A major risk is that the company’s investigations do not lead to further activities that can contribute to the realisation of the SDGs, sustainable growth and employment and responsible business conduct in accordance with the principles of the UN Global Compact and the UN guiding principles for business and human rights.
